mont_curator.text: Welcome to the Heritage Museum. We've got an Amerindian canoe, a plantation bell, a Carib pot and a very large photograph of Plymouth. It was a handsome town.
The museum's a mix of the island's history: Amerindian, Irish, African and British. It's got a harp. Nobody's allowed to play it. Everyone has.

mont_kid.text: My nan used to live in Plymouth. She says the town clock was always wrong by about ten minutes, and everybody liked it that way.
We're learning about the 1768 plan. The uprising didn't work. But it's why we've got St Patrick's Day as a freedom day.
